# GAIA

> GAIA is a harness for Claude Code: rules, hooks, agents, and memory that govern the whole project and give Claude enough structure to be trusted as the sole engineer on the project, turning raw capability into work you can ship. Engineering leaders at growing teams use GAIA to make AI trustworthy enough to own features end-to-end. The AI reads GAIA's enforced coding rules, clears the Code Audit Team on every pull request, follows Agentic Design patterns purpose-built for React, and writes to a shared Obsidian wiki so project knowledge survives across sessions. Maintenance runs on demand on your own machine: dependency updates with security-advisory fixes, a tech-debt backlog that drains through the same audit gate, and wiki upkeep, with statusline nudges when something needs attention. The result: a production-ready React codebase built at AI speed, with the structure and discipline that holds under pressure. Claude is raw power. GAIA is order and focus.

GAIA installs with one command, `npx create-gaia@latest my-app`, and scaffolds a pnpm workspace with a React 19 app in `frontend/` and the harness built in: enforced coding rules, the Code Audit Team on every merge, Agentic Design patterns, an Obsidian wiki for durable project knowledge, and a full test stack (Vitest, Playwright, MSW, Storybook, Chromatic). Bring your own backend beside it. Open source, written by one developer (so far). Contributors and sponsors welcome.

## Site

- [GAIA: A serious harness for Claude Code](https://gaiaharness.com/): What GAIA is, who it's for, and the core idea: structure that holds under pressure.
- [Why Claude Code Breaks Without Structure](https://gaiaharness.com/why/): The case for project-level discipline in AI-built code, and why vibe coding falls apart at scale.
- [Features](https://gaiaharness.com/features/): Coding rules, the Code Audit Team, Agentic Design patterns, the Obsidian wiki, token economics, and on-demand maintenance, covered pattern by pattern.
- [Get Started](https://gaiaharness.com/get-started/): Install GAIA in one command, and what `npx create-gaia` sets up.
- [Consulting](https://gaiaharness.com/consulting/): Hands-on help adopting GAIA and Claude Code: Audit, Migration, Foundation, or Retainer, by the creator.
- [About Steven Sacks](https://gaiaharness.com/about/): Creator of GAIA, and the original GAIA Flash Framework back in 2008.
- [Changelog](https://gaiaharness.com/changelog/): Every shipped version of GAIA, newest first, with new features, improvements, and fixes.
